Frequently in treatment I would consume large amounts of DXM, weather it be Robo pills, cough syrup, or coricidin. I  had UA testing 2 times a week and I have never shown up positive for anything. Others in my treatment group also did DXM with me on occasion, and their UA results came back negative as well.
